metadata.title: AutomatedLabDefinition
metadata.description: The module creates the lab and machine definition for the AutomatedLab module saved in XML
metadata.authors: Raimund Andree Per Pedersen Jan-Hendrik Peters

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Add-LabDomainDefinition' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$AdminPassword' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
